messages:
Eli (design): Quick theme spike pushed to staging — tweaked console dark palette and reduced the ‘glow’ on code blocks. Also experimented with a new chart palette to improve differential for red/green use cases. Screenshot + small CSS snippet below. Please eyeball on your machines.

Priya: Saw it. Code blocks are much less aggressive — nice. The inline token highlight (the yellow) still has low contrast on the panel bg (#0B0F14). Quick axe check shows ~2.8:1.

Samir: Yep, and the area chart gradient fades into the panel — small-value lines disappear. Suggest solid color lines for thin series, gradient for big ones.

Jo: Nit: tooltip copy in the capacity modal says "dedicated GPU pools" (gpu lowercase). Can we standardize to "GPU" everywhere? Also the keyboard focus on the toggles is barely visible — outline blends into the dark bg.

Luca: Quick idea: swap token highlight from #FFD54A -> #FFB74D or try #F1C40F. Need contrast numbers though.

theme-bot: color-contrast-check: #FFD54A on #0B0F14 => 2.7:1; #FFB74D => 3.1:1; #F1C40F => 4.7:1 (passes AA for 14px+)

Priya: #F1C40F technically passes but very saturated — can cause chromatic vibration on small text. Maybe desaturate slightly and shift toward amber. #D9A800 yields ~4.6:1 and looks calmer.

Eli (design): I like #D9A800 if it keeps the visual emphasis without the buzz. For charts I drafted a palette that aims for hue separation and CVD robustness — see snippet below.

Eli (design): ```
:root {
  --bg: #0B0F14;
  --panel: rgba(15,20,24,0.72);
  --code-bg: #0f1317;
  --code-shadow: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
  --token-hl: #D9A800; /* amber, 4.6:1 */
  --accent-1: #7DD3FC; /* aqua */
  --accent-2: #60A5FA; /* blue */
  --accent-3: #A78BFA; /* purple */
  --accent-4: #FBBF24; /* gold */
  --accent-5: #FB7185; /* rose */
}
```

theme-bot: simulated-cvd: palette passes deutan & protan checks for primary series, but accent-4 (gold) vs accent-5 (rose) have reduced separation on low-saturation screens.

Samir: For tiny markers, rely on shape + color (circle vs square) not color alone. Also increase stroke from 1px -> 2px on mobile to keep visibility when scaled.

Jo: Copy nits: change "use dedicated capacity" tooltip to "Reserve Dedicated GPU capacity". Also add alt text for the thumbnail in the modal (accessibility).

Eli (design): Plan: set token highlight -> #D9A800, adopt the palette above, reduce code-block outer shadow, and increase keyboard focus to 3px dashed #2A6FFF for contrast. I'll open a PR with visual diffs and include automated a11y checks (contrast and simulated CVD snapshots). @Priya can you run through copy changes and the tooltip wording?

Priya: Will do a quick pass and push suggestions inline. Also prefer the sample code font-size at 13px for tighter density — devs asked for that in the last UX sync.

Luca: Please validate on macOS retina + Windows 150% scaling. Small screens show different gamma and might reintroduce the "buzz" on the amber.

Jo: :thumbsup: Also add a screenshot checklist to the PR description (mac retina, win scale, linux, firefox/chrome) so QE can smoke test.

Eli (design): Thanks all — I'll tag screenshots in the PR and link the staging build. Expect PR in the next hour. If anyone catches other contrast weirdness, drop screenshots here and I'll iterate.
